categories.name: Commodity-backed Stablecoin
categories.content: A commodity-backed stablecoin is a type of stablecoin designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to a reserve of physical commodities such as gold.

categories.name: Tourism
categories.content: A coin or token that leverages blockchain technology to improve various aspects of the tourism industry.

categories.name: Quest-to-Earn
categories.content: Quest-to-Earn refers to a gamified system in which users complete specific tasks or challenges to earn rewards, which can be in the form of points, tokens, or other incentives.

categories.name: Virtual Reality
categories.content: Virtual reality (VR) uses computer-generated environments to create a simulated experience for users.

categories.name: Binance Megadrop
categories.content: Binance Megadrop is an airdrop program by Binance. It allows users to earn rewards by subscribing to BNB to Locked Products and completing tasks within their Binance Web3 Wallet.

categories.name: DeFAI
categories.content: DeFAI or AIFI projects leverage AI to streamline and automate DeFi activities such as trading, staking, yield farming, market analysis, and investment optimization.

categories.name: Sui Meme
categories.content: Meme coins native to the Sui network.

categories.name: Education
categories.content: Decentralized educational platform built on blockchain technology.

categories.name: ST0x Ecosystem
categories.content: Tokenized public equities and capital market instruments issued on the st0x.io platform.

categories.name: Reality Ecosystem
categories.content: Reality is a platform by Bitget that issues tokenized real-world assets (like U.S. stocks and ETFs) backed 1:1 by securities, bringing them on-chain with stablecoin dividend payments.

categories.name: Game Studio
categories.content: A game studio develops video games using blockchain technologies, integrating NFTs, cryptocurrencies, and smart contracts to enable player ownership and the trading of in-game assets

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Christmas Themed

categories.name: Healthcare

categories.name: Surge Launchpad

categories.name: CreatorBid Ecosystem
categories.content: CreatorBid Ecosystem consists of tokens launched via creator.bid.

categories.name: Decentralized Social Media (DeSOC)
categories.content: Decentralized Social Media (DeSOC) refers to social media platforms and protocols that operate without a central authority over user data, content, or infrastructure.
